name: codex-cr-loop
description: Codex review loop commands with three completion modes (review-only stop, local merge, push + open PR). v1.7.0 review protocol: class-format findings (Pattern / Instances / Fix / Prevent — every instance, fixed in one pass) returned as schema-validated JSON (codex exec --output-schema; the verdict is never parsed from prose); round 1 reviews the whole branch diff, later rounds review only the diff since the last reviewed head; a per-branch no-repeat ledger (stable class ids, stored under .git, survives across invocations) is passed to every round; round cap CR_LOOP_ROUND_CAP=3 dirty rounds triggers a mandatory step-back round (recurring classes, approach change per class, prevention), then incremental rounds resume, and a second cap hit after CR_LOOP_MAX_STEP_BACKS=1 asks the user; recurring classes must be codified at the source (lint rule, source-guard test, or REVIEW.md entry). Converges on two consecutive clean rounds on the same HEAD, the second over the whole diff. Reviewer is codex exec (read-only sandbox, model_reasoning_effort=high, detached, stdin /dev/null) via scripts/cr-review.sh — no 1 MiB diff limit. Keeps the always-on interaction-logic guard, preflight base-currency gate, /cr-loop-pr auto-rebase + confirmation round, head-drift check, P3-skip default and the Chinese business-impact summary (3–8 lines, or the literal 无业务逻辑影响). Replaces the v1.6 widening guard / auto-widening sweep. v1.8.0: review rules (REVIEW.md / AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md) are read from the review base commit, never the branch under review (codex runs with project_doc_max_bytes=0); the branch's rule-file edits are reviewed content — additions allowed, removed or rewritten rules return needs-human until a person approves them (ack-rules, fingerprint-bound); finish also catches HEAD moving away and back and uncommitted edits during a round. v1.8.1: atomic pending.tx recovery across all state writers (cr-tx.sh), persisted clean_streak + strict two-round/post-rebase convergence proof, .gitattributes-immune raw blob rule inspection (--no-relative/--no-abbrev), versioned fail-closed tree_fp v2 (including untracked files), post-convergence RECURRING scoping, strict JSON duplicate-key/additionalProperties validation, ps -ww runner check, bounded wait backoff, and /cr-loop-pr Step 8.0 base-update + pre-rebase pinned lease.
